Neither **L-cysteine** nor **N-acetylcysteine (NAC)** is a proven hangover cure, and clinical evidence for both is mixed. ` [Highlight start] L-cysteine is a free amino acid that may bind acetaldehyde and ease certain hangover symptoms, while NAC is an acetylated form of cysteine that acts as a precursor to the antioxidant glutathione [Highlight end] `.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXsQw_sJUshM4GOaONi14XUQT05-UgqK_pH0Kl49xjZilCNoHuEPJGXfNo7cbYkD016r-fMXbYS6M2m9LuKuZl3M2mqqBK1-Vm9anTWNCPdqPTpQ4K0S2jyOfQaCw76Hi8jOkMi2zD9A)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYgHEIkXX4qERtGV11aUrmLIZpCQzFta6mVENWPkJRPvOTvy1tlDQ2S9ZxziwMFh-OVj7F1lx2wSEt0ZnicXO2Dy2Glqve5ApablM3AEnMXJ4qMjD6iE33H2A0As6aRqvl-Nb)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF12NnsQ32o5lrcJkzt2v-p6Ief4Lm4naG4GY6O42Y_WYWb-WxOm9w0A_fuSygdcV3RGA3fodwkCp5wV8-FTSeX2oNVzHhxw1aMRh7WAp8DBrVBoA6sd3tRjuMsGYRIVEPzKshG4qQwvKPfZpmjLkYERVd52gevKCDB_IbOw)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHEIkXX6EhtGvkkve4Bqx9mm7SvX0a727O9asMsjO0umeJSMi7FbAKu4WbnvSaDRTR6w2aOJgktnewEBupd5sZd8bmVLMj78RT5azCaE0muxtLfg_VDmAySAuvNtNIc78ZSgS8)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjQEBxCJF1xfgFzGkl7RrJ0DQ6mV82BlgOd0WMsRd5ElOxHLKxVRpwQ5hV1tVi0_juj8_kZ57cpbFqaLRGizjJPKZ0qp3PsAII-0Wv3kMGxEPPHWw9gWkJdkH1SKMDzxjU87z4C3vTLKx7PRWo14ZH8mxmltdxd8yy0ed-caq5ikwb8UfZA-d0SfLX_-FLyA)[[6]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXXSHVS-ig8w-IfuF6otBIxRWE2d5CodZpHQucmK9OP4Ajsl2fv6UvloQ57QGu_xUuEjbwI_ly0ckKPsDv1mThIpgn0swNnIBzZZEAbaXvB7vw54lCdggu7spmxKRx0s30iwV0bkMh0aDo4Uhgill5iiyzjqgA1jJ-Iw)

### How They Differ for Hangovers

- **L-cysteine:** A small placebo-controlled study found that 1,200 mg of L-cysteine reduced hangover symptoms like nausea and headache, while 600 mg lowered stress and anxiety. Researchers suggest it may help neutralize acetaldehyde, a toxic alcohol byproduct, though larger studies are still needed.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHEIkXX6EhtGvkkve4Bqx9mm7SvX0a727O9asMsjO0umeJSMi7FbAKu4WbnvSaDRTR6w2aOJgktnewEBupd5sZd8bmVLMj78RT5azCaE0muxtLfg_VDmAySAuvNtNIc78ZSgS8)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjQEBxCJF1xfgFzGkl7RrJ0DQ6mV82BlgOd0WMsRd5ElOxHLKxVRpwQ5hV1tVi0_juj8_kZ57cpbFqaLRGizjJPKZ0qp3PsAII-0Wv3kMGxEPPHWw9gWkJdkH1SKMDzxjU87z4C3vTLKx7PRWo14ZH8mxmltdxd8yy0ed-caq5ikwb8UfZA-d0SfLX_-FLyA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF12NnsQ32o5lrcJkzt2v-p6Ief4Lm4naG4GY6O42Y_WYWb-WxOm9w0A_fuSygdcV3RGA3fodwkCp5wV8-FTSeX2oNVzHhxw1aMRh7WAp8DBrVBoA6sd3tRjuMsGYRIVEPzKshG4qQwvKPfZpmjLkYERVd52gevKCDB_IbOw)
- **NAC:** NAC supplies cysteine to help rebuild glutathione levels in the liver. However, a 2024 randomized, double-blind clinical trial found NAC ineffective at alleviating binge-drinking hangover symptoms or reducing oxidative stress markers , and earlier research noted potential liver risks if taken after alcohol exposure in animal models.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYgHEIkXX4qERtGV11aUrmLIZpCQzFta6mVENWPkJRPvOTvy1tlDQ2S9ZxziwMFh-OVj7F1lx2wSEt0ZnicXO2Dy2Glqve5ApablM3AEnMXJ4qMjD6iE33H2A0As6aRqvl-Nb)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXXSHVS-ig8w-IfuF6otBIxRWE2d5CodZpHQucmK9OP4Ajsl2fv6UvloQ57QGu_xUuEjbwI_ly0ckKPsDv1mThIpgn0swNnIBzZZEAbaXvB7vw54lCdggu7spmxKRx0s30iwV0bkMh0aDo4Uhgill5iiyzjqgA1jJ-Iw)

### Key Takeaways & Safety

- **Evidence is limited:** Neither supplement prevents dehydration or replaces pacing alcohol intake and rehydrating.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF12NnsQ32o5lrcJkzt2v-p6Ief4Lm4naG4GY6O42Y_WYWb-WxOm9w0A_fuSygdcV3RGA3fodwkCp5wV8-FTSeX2oNVzHhxw1aMRh7WAp8DBrVBoA6sd3tRjuMsGYRIVEPzKshG4qQwvKPfZpmjLkYERVd52gevKCDB_IbOw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYgHEIkXX4qERtGV11aUrmLIZpCQzFta6mVENWPkJRPvOTvy1tlDQ2S9ZxziwMFh-OVj7F1lx2wSEt0ZnicXO2Dy2Glqve5ApablM3AEnMXJ4qMjD6iE33H2A0As6aRqvl-Nb)
- **Side effects:** Both can cause gastrointestinal upset such as nausea, and NAC carries regulatory scrutiny when marketed aggressively for hangovers.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXsQw_sJUshM4GOaONi14XUQT05-UgqK_pH0Kl49xjZilCNoHuEPJGXfNo7cbYkD016r-fMXbYS6M2m9LuKuZl3M2mqqBK1-Vm9anTWNCPdqPTpQ4K0S2jyOfQaCw76Hi8jOkMi2zD9A)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHEIkXX6EhtGvkkve4Bqx9mm7SvX0a727O9asMsjO0umeJSMi7FbAKu4WbnvSaDRTR6w2aOJgktnewEBupd5sZd8bmVLMj78RT5azCaE0muxtLfg_VDmAySAuvNtNIc78ZSgS8)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXXSHVS-ig8w-IfuF6otBIxRWE2d5CodZpHQucmK9OP4Ajsl2fv6UvloQ57QGu_xUuEjbwI_ly0ckKPsDv1mThIpgn0swNnIBzZZEAbaXvB7vw54lCdggu7spmxKRx0s30iwV0bkMh0aDo4Uhgill5iiyzjqgA1jJ-Iw)
